batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: lbw b RE van der Merwe

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b UT Yadav

batting.name: LR Shukla
batting.dismissal: c Y Nagar b UT Yadav

batting.name: R Bhatia
batting.dismissal: st NV Ojha b RE van der Merwe

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c Iqbal Abdulla b R Bhatia

balls.text: Gone, run-out! Super piece of work from Umesh Yadav. It was driven by Lee to the deep square-leg and the batsmen went for a second. Yadav got the direct hit from that region and Lee was caught way, way short!
Had the chance to go again, it was not pitched right up but he missed it.
Maximum! Finally they get one off a full-toss! Smacks it over long-off for the six after the batsmen before him had missed out on aplenty.
Pitched on the leg stump, up to the bat and Abdulla drives it to long-on.
He is gone, stumped! Pitched right up to the bat and Bhatia missed after coming down the track. Namane Ojha gathered it well and chopped the bails off their roots.
Full-toss and smashed to long-on for a run.
Well-bowled to end a superb over. Pitched up to the bat and Lee almost looked uncertain whether to go forward or back, whether to defend or smash. In the end, the drive gets him a single.
Fullish ball on the off-stump and that is a single drilled to the sweeper fence.

Gone this time! Caught at long-on, it was a good length ball but Shukla failed to gauge it too well and did not get the meat of the bat. The mistimed shot went only up to the long-on fielder who takes it comfortably.
Outside the off-stump and he tried to free the arms. Misses again!
Swings at the short ball and he misses it completely.
Yorker length and drilled well to the long-on region for a single.
Attempts a hoick but gets nothing substantial on it.
Driven to long-on for a single.
Another full-toss missed! Tries to hit over the long-on, gets only a single to the same fielder.
Shortish and the batsman flicks it away to the deep mid-wicket region for a single
Full-toss and drives it to long-off for a run.
Huge! One of the bigger sixes tonight as Shukla winds up and puts him into the stand behind mid-wicket.
Driven down the ground to long-on for a single.
This time he attempts a pull but misses it completely. Still 12 runs already off the over.
Cut away to the cover fence for four! That was coming into the batsman, an attempt by the bowler to cramp him but he managed to get that cut going!
Pitched up again and drilled to the long-on. Morkel dives to his right and prevents it from rolling into the fence and they get a couple.
In the slot and Shukla smacks it over long-off for a big one! Valuable runs from a very good lower-order batsman!
Tries to drive through the leg-side but misses the timing.
Up in the air as the attempt at hara-kiri continued. Luckily for Shukla it fell between long-on and long-off and the batsman survives.
A tad short but turning away from the bat and played it away for a single to mid-wicket.
Short of a length and he cuts it away for a single.
Paddle sweeps it to fine-leg and by the time the tall Morne Morkel picks it up at fine-leg, they run two.
Cut away for a single to sweeper.
Defended on the off-side.
Played away to the third-man for a single.

Run-out! That is a silly one given the circumstances. Shukla pulled it away for an easy single but Das wanted a second. He ran, there never seemed any calling from them and he found himself at the same end as Shukla. Das has to follow his captain back.

Bowled him! Morkel has another wicket, and it is a big one. Gambhir tried to run it down to the third-man but only got an inside-edge that found its way to the stumps. A bail went down and Gambhir goes to the pavilion.
Played it on the off-side and runs away for a single. That was smart batting but Maxwell swooped down, got the ball and threw it down, all very quickly. Umpire calls for a review but he is just in.
Six more! Where has he come from! Morkel tried a slower ball and Das swung it real hard, goes over long-on for a six!
Pitched up but rather wide and Gambhir easily pushes it to the deep cover for a single
Pitched up and that is been smacked right out of the fence for the first six of the innings!
Short again and he pulls hard, this time to deep mid-wicket. Yadav runs hard and flicks it back inside the arena and saves two.
Short and this time Gambhir gets some bat on that cut.
Turns away, but beaten
Dropped! Short ball and it was pulled away by the right-handed Das, went straight to the deep mid-wicket where Yadav makes a mess of it.
Lot of turn there for Maxwell and it goes down the leg-side for a wide.
Cut away to backward point for a single
Another one that is pitched on length, jags back into the batsman who stutters while padding it away to the slips.
Another one short of a good length and the batsman had no chance of getting any bat there. Suddenly, he is pitching them short!
Short this time and the batsman allows it go through to the keeper.
Edged away by Das and it goes racing away to the fence...well almost. Venugopal Rao dives at third-man and restricts it to only two. Well fielded by Rao.
Nurdled it away to the leg-side by Gambhir for a single.
Drives straight to the fielder in the covers.
Gone! That was a weird short to say the least, length ball and Pathan wanted to duck under it. The ball did not rise enough and all he did was to get a glove to that and the keeper did the rest!
Driven back but straight to the fielder.
Immediately shortens the length and Gambhir nudges it away to the third-man fielder.
Full-toss on the off-stump and Gambhir finds the gap on the off-side. Driven through for a four.
Another yorker and Pathan is beaten for pace. Hits his pad but it was going down the leg-side and the ball goes away to the leg-side.
Pitches it right up to the bat and Gambhir defends it to mid-off. Darts off to a quick one.
yes, it is a yorker alright! But a tad misdirected, down the leg-side and Pathan got something on to it. It wasn't bat but it was enough for the ball to roll away for a four down the fine-leg fence.

Bowled again! Similar ball, pitched right up and Tiwary went back on his crease, trying to defend, could not get his bat down in time and the stumps get pegged back. Three down and Morkel's on a hat-trick.
Yorker, bowled! South African bowls out another South African! It was pitched right up, Kallis tried to flick it away to the leg-side but missed and down went the timber.
Gives room again by going down the leg-side but Morkel shortens his length and only a single.
Shot, did not try to hit it hard, and chipped the fullish ball over mid-on for a four.
Pacy ball, outside the off-stump and Gambhir goes for a swing. Misses completely. There is a slip in place for him.
Goes down the track and chips it away to the leg-side for a run. End of a wicket-taking over from van der Merwe.
Short of length, and turning into Gambhir, who defends well.

Gone! He tried to repeat that same shot that went for four. Not short and he still went on to the back-foot, tried to swing it away to the deep square-leg fence but missed, caught in front of the wickets.
Down the leg-side and he leaves it alone. Wide called...
Flighted right up to the batsman and the opener from New Zealand defends.
Superb shot! Was not even short and McCullum still went on to the back-foot and smacked it to the deep square-leg fence!
Pitched up but more vitally for Kallis, down the leg-side. Kallis needed no second invites and he flicks it away to the same region where McCullum got his boundary. Good start for KKR!
Kept a bit low that one that pitched a tad short. Kallis defends but still to get off the mark.
Another one that shapes into the batsman and Kallis stands tall and drives it back to the bowler.
Nudged that delivery shaping into the bat towards the right of mid-on for a single.
Charges down the pitch and smacks Pathan over square-leg for a four! It was a matter of time and it came as early as the second ball.
Little bit of movement into the bat and McCullum defends on the back-foot.
Full-toss and it has been flicked over the square-leg fielder for a four! Delhi have won with five balls to spare!
Nudged away to the leg-side and gets a single.
Goes down a couple of steps and lifts it over the extra-cover region for a four that had grace written all over it!
Attempts a sweep and is hit on the pads again. The keeper screams, to no avail.
Quicker, flatter and Pathan cuts Pathan away to the sweeper.
Turn for Pathan and the batsman is hit on his pads. They still run for a leg-bye.
Nudged away to the on-side for a run. Only 10 more needed.
Played away for a single and retains strike.
Biggie! Pathan's got his third six and that did not hit the middle either! He has changed it around with those two sixes.
Short again and Pathan has smacked it away again! But this time there is a fielder there and they run two.
Another ball in the block-hole and played it out to mid-wicket for a run.
Yorker length from that height and Pathan does well to dig it out to mid-on.
Smash! Short ball from de Lange and Pathan hits the sweetest part of the bat, it goes the distance.
Played away to the off-side for a single
Finally connected and the pressure is lifted off for now. Far too many singles and dot balls before this but this time it was right in the slot and Pathan smashes it over long-on.
Good short one and that is only a single off that pull.

Pitched in the slot but it seemed a tad slower and Pathan does not connect properly. had he connected a tad more, it may have gone into the long-on's hands. And a little more than that, it would have cleared him. Only a single here.
Driven to the covers and the non-striker is sent back by Pathan.
Tries to drive it over the covers but did not get it off the middle and that falls just short of the fielder.
Another slower one and the batsman had no idea about it. A stifled appeal but an excellent over there, only three from it.
Nudged away to the leg-side for a single.
Slower one and this time it is driven to the leg-side for a run.
Driven towards the extra-cover and its gone straight to the fielder.

Slower one and that is very well caught by the fielder at the long-on fence! Sehwag wanted to hit it over mid-wicket but the lack of pace caused the problem and Abdulla ran in front of his own dug-out to take that catch!
Good length and driven down the ground by Pathan.
Flashed hard by Sehwag and it goes racing to the point fence. Spoils a good over from Kallis.
Shortish and pulled away for a single. Good over so far.
Hit on the up but straight to the fielder.
Yorker again and dug out well by Pathan. That was a single, converted into two by Pathan but Sehwag did not look too comfortable going for it. Nearly a run-out.
Tries to make some room and cut it away but misses. The bowler does not and the castle looks troubled. De Lange's bouncer that hit Finch, could have had something to do with that.
Short ball from Kallis and hits the high part of Sehwag's bat. Only for a single
Another yorker and well dug out by Sehwag for a single. De Lange seems to be bowling only two lengths currently, very full or very short.
Short ball and it has hit Finch this time! Flush on his helmet and an inevitable exchange of words follows!
This time he pitches it right up to the bat but the batsman is able to get it easily away to long-on.
Short again and this time the ball is pulled away for a single.
Pulled away by Finch and that is gone so quickly that the fine-leg was left stranded. Extra pace from the bowler and the quick outfield helps as well!
Short, quick and it has hit and hurt Virender Sehwag. He is down...
Tries to go for a slog but does not connect and it only rolls away for a single.
That is pitched right up to the bat and coming back into the batsman. He is hit on his pads and there is a bit of an appeal from somewhere, but in vain.
That went away from the right-handed batsman! Beaten!
Tries to cut it away but it hits the bottom of the bat and races away. This time Das runs to his left and restricts him to two.
The ball jags back in with the angle and Finch tries to run it down to third-man. Does not get too much of a bat.
That was flayed away but this time the third-man fielder ran towards the ball at the sweeper and restricts it to a single.
Tries to sweep it away but does not time it too well, Goes to the square-leg region.
Went down the leg-stump to give himself a lot of room but the bowler followed him and he defends again.
Defended well on the front-foot.
Pushes the ball away for a single to mid-wicket.
Pitched up, did not spin too much and Sehwag's dismissed it from his presence! Goes over long-on.
Played away on the leg-side for a run.
Played it away to the third-man and a single for Finch. Which means that Sehwag will not get the strike again!
Driven straight to the short mid-wicket and there isn't much of a chance for a single.
Full-toss and the batsman flicks it away to the mid-wicket for his second set of consecutive boundaries!
Bad, bad fielding from the man at third-man, that was cut away to that region and that should have been fielded. He dived to his right but the ball popped out and rolls away to the fence.
Defended carefully to the covers for no run.
Short and into the body of Sehwag, who hops on to the back-foot and gets a single off that flick to square-leg.
Cut away to the sweeper fence and that is two fours in a row for Finch!
Pitched right up but it is not quite a yorker and Finch flicked it away to the right of mid-on for a four!
Defends on the front foot. Finch is itching to have a go here.
Short ball but going down the leg-side and Finch went for the hook. Missed it and despite the appeal from everywhere, the umpire calls it a wide. Rightly so.
Length ball played away to the deep backward square-leg region for a single
This time it is pitched slightly up and Finch taps it to the mid-wicket region.
Short and pegs the batsman on his back-foot. Defended for no run.
Pitched up to the bat and it is driven to the mid-off fielder. He is right up to the circle and an easy single results.
Tries to cut it away but the ball sneaks through under the bat. Done in for pace.
Good length, outside the off-stump and that is defended away. Did I spot a hint of away swing?
And this time it is a length ball, and nudged away to the square-leg region. Misfield allows the batsmen to come back for a second.
A yorker followed by a short one to Sehwag and he stands up tall, flicks it to fine-leg.
Yorker length ball and dug out well by Finch. And off they go for a run.
